mentions.description: An idea for an IDE with a full agentic plugin that 'ablates' functions or pieces of code for the user to complete, so practice means building toward a real program instead of leetCode-style exercises. It would also guide users with bug fixes and other tasks, and includes a fully integrated DOS environment with a fully functioning debugger and asset editors. It also works on iPad. No project name or link is given in the source.
mentions.problem: Implied: leetCode-style exercises do not build toward real programs; this would let learners complete real code pieces toward an actual program while still learning.
mentions.audience: People learning to program who want to practice by building real software, including on iPad.
mentions.author: yoz-y
